name: Path Tracing Engine (Radiance iOS Chapter 2.2/2.3)
description: Live path tracing from the real Minecraft world: ingests chunk meshes + vertex-color/UV albedo into Metal acceleration structures (2.1 sealed contract), renders progressively accumulated frames (sun direct + shadow rays + diffuse bounces) and composites them onto the game framebuffer via a Window.swapBuffers mixin + GL blit (2.3), with atlas-textured albedo read back from GL. v0.5.1 (2.4 first cut): event-driven ingestion — a ChunkBuilder.BuiltChunk.setData mixin pumps mesh-published events into a resident Pathtrace-Ingest thread (50ms latency, alpha cutout, ping-pong from t=0), with a 2s full-sweep sentry as fallback so world edits keep flowing into the RT scene for the whole session. Radiance iOS port, chapter 2 stage 2.4.
